Electromechanical components have augmented the firing mechanism to permit round acceleration via a poorly-understood consequence of the Hall effect on beryllium-bronze alloys, allowing for barrel velocities of up to ten times of the original’s design.

Yes, excellent.

item.content:encoded: Awesome. I'm a sucker for epistolary formats, and this does it so well. A bunch of threads all interweaving into one, but more impressively, it always keeps the trick just out of site, letting the reader make out what's going on through the gaps. Rad stuff.

item.content:encoded: I'm very impressed by how efficiently the series draws together all these discrete strings without at any point seeming particularly rushed or slapdash. The narrowing focus from this somewhat nebulous beginning keeps momentum going in a way that makes it very hard to stop reading at any point.
